gen-gf-phudu-gf-pt-sans: Phudu draws every letter with one flat, pressure-free line, like a ballpoint that never leans. And PT Sans reads friendly and approachable below it, its c curling open as a plain arc.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-reddit-sans: Reddit Sans takes the quieter seat beneath the bold Phudu. Its e opens wide at the terminal and strokes hold one thickness in every direction, so paragraphs move along smoothly.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-rosario: Rosario reads contemporary and approachable, the ends of its c never turning inward, which keeps each line of text open. Phudu shouts in constant-width outlines while Rosario murmurs underneath.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-ruluko: Approachable and clean, Ruluko opens broad counters on its c and s, giving the text a friendly, easy face. Phudu hands over bold monoweight strokes, and Ruluko softens them.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-sarala: Phudu opens bold, drawing every line like a ballpoint. The single best quality here is the shared openness: Sarala's gaps in c, e and s echo Phudu's generous curve endings.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Pen-flat and punchy, Phudu holds its lines to one thickness through every curve. And Sawarabi Gothic, with open jaws on every curved stroke, reads smooth and unfussy through paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-shippori-antique-b1: Phudu draws every curve with a ballpoint's plain, pressure-free line and leaves generous openings at each terminal. Shippori Antique B1 is a modern sans with daylight through every curve, so text moves along clearly.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-sn-pro: SN Pro reads modern and neutral, its open aperture curves running through the whole alphabet without a snag. And paragraphs in it settle into a smooth, unhurried rhythm under Phudu's bold, stem-matched diagonals.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-spinnaker: Phudu is bold and distinctive, drawn with one steady thickness. Shrink that heading and the outlines lose their punch, while Spinnaker keeps its apertures open and modern at any size.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-tajawal: Phudu's uninterrupted line width on every letter gives it a bold, ballpoint-plain look. Tajawal, with its broad open hook of a c, keeps extended text clean and easy on the eye.
